question.text: Which one of the following statements about packing in solids is incorrect ?

options.text: Coordination number in bcc mode of packing is 8 .
Coordination number in hep mode of packing is 12 .
Void space in hcp mode of packing is $32 \%$.
Void space in ccp mode of packing is $26 \%$.

solution.text: The $h c p$ arrangement of atoms occupies $74 \%$ of the available space and thus has $26 \%$ vacant space.
